description: Rust framework for Nervos CKB smart contracts. Calculate assembles a transaction off chain. Verify checks that transaction on chain.
rules: Scaffold a contract from templates/contract. Do not start from ckb-cinnabar-scripts-template.
Calculate is an Instruction of Operations off chain. Verify is a cinnabar_main! tree on chain.
Use intent names only when a hop is exactly create, transfer, or burn. Otherwise use a domain string and Instruction::new.
Custom script errors start at 20. System codes are 1-5, the verify tree uses 10-11, and SSRI uses 12-18.
Accept the work only when make build and make test both exit 0. Deploy with ckb-cinnabar --json --dry-run.
Install the CLI with cargo install --git https://github.com/ashuralyk/ckb-cinnabar. SSRI is the default verifier feature.
